dedupe_keys.name: 112年11月雲林縣消防安全設備查察處理統計 fire police and emergency services series on taiwan government open data platform

description: 112年11月雲林縣消防安全設備查察處理統計 [fire, police and emergency services] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 雲林縣消防局. 凡在雲林縣依據消防法第6條第1項規定應設消防安全設備之場所均為統計對象. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 12 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 雲林縣消防局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx, csv, xml, json. The portal shows 2024-01-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
